entity.name: Fluxverys Yazilim Teknolojileri Ticaret Ltd. Sti.
entity.description: Software company in Ankara, Turkiye, building virtual tour and 3D reconstruction software. We develop Tourision, a production SaaS that turns consumer 360-degree camera footage into virtual tours and Gaussian-splat 3D models, and we started OpenTour to give this entire category of data an open, portable, vendor-neutral format.

projects.name: OpenTour
projects.description: An open, portable package format for virtual tours: panoramas, scene graph, hotspots, floor plans, multi-language content, accessibility metadata and licensing, with optional 3D assets (point clouds, Gaussian splats) in existing open formats. Planned tooling: reference read/write library and CLI, validator and conformance suite, converters from closed platforms (Matterport, Kuula, Pano2VR), and a panorama processing library (seam correction, nadir patching, projection conversion, privacy blurring). Goal: museums, municipalities, archives and small businesses can own and preserve their spatial records without vendor lock-in.

channels.description: International wire transfer (SWIFT) to our company account in Turkiye. Details shared on request via info@fluxverys.com.

plans.name: OpenTour specification v1.0 and reference tooling
plans.description: Funds the specification, reference read/write library and CLI, validator and conformance test suite, and converters from three closed platforms. Estimated at 150 person-days of engineering work.

plans.name: Open panorama processing toolkit
plans.description: Funds the open-source panorama processing library: seam correction with measurable quality metrics, tripod/nadir patching, horizon levelling, projection conversion, and projection-aware face and licence-plate blurring for privacy.

plans.name: Sustaining development
plans.description: Ongoing maintenance of the specification, tooling and test data set.

history.description: Project started in August 2026; no funding received yet. Development is currently financed by Fluxverys out of its own revenue.
